description: Detached residential refurbishment with single-storey rear and side extension, lower ground floor extension, loft conversion with rear dormer and raised ridge, solar panels, replacement windows, and boundary wall alterations.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 0353-DR-0001, 0353-HLA-DR-0002, 1190, 1200, 1210, 1220, 1230, 2200, 2210, 2220 & BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Constraints Plan, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan dated April 2025.

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Removal of PD (Windows/Doors) - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no openings shall be constructed in the east facing side elevation of the lower ground and ground floor rear extension without planning permission first being obtained from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Obscured Glazing (Fixed Shut) - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the window in the east elevation of the lower ground and ground floor rear extension shall be glazed with obscure glass and fixed shut below 1.8m internal floor height and shall permanently maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 6 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the lower ground and ground floor rear extension hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Condition : 7 - Landscaping - The development shall not be occupied until full details of a landscaping and planting scheme, which shall include the planting of a minimum of 3 semi-mature native trees (Heavy Standard - girth 12 - 14cm) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These works shall be carried out as approved before first occupation of the development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include on a plan, full details of the size, species, spacing, quantities and location of proposed plants, together with any hard surfacing, means of enclosure. The approved details shall be permanetly retained thereafter.

Condition : 8 - Tree Protection - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved document: BS 5837:2012 Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Constraints Plan, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan dated April 2025. The details and measures as approved shall be retained and maintained, until the completion of all site operations.

Condition : 9 - Site Supervision (Trees) - The details of the Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection Plan shall include the retention of an arboricultural expert to supervise, monitor and report to the LPA not less than monthly the status of all tree works and tree protection measures throughout the course of the construction period. At the conclusion of the construction period the arboricultural expert shall submit to the LPA a satisfactory completion statement to demonstrate compliance with the approved protection measures.

Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved [without delay/ with an agreed determination date].

Condition : 11 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works
